result.explanation: Maintain permanent ID records and unique sequence reservations. Existing IDs are duplicate only when both original fields match; otherwise conflict. New IDs below next are stale, while sequences already reserved conflict. Accepted records are repeatedly applied in sequence order from next.
result.mapping: state.n is the next unapplied sequence, state.v is accumulated value, and state.a stores permanent [id,seq,delta] records. Reservations include applied records. Each output reports status, current value, next, and sorted pending sequences.
result.assumptions: Inputs follow the stated event contract and use safe integers. The implementation treats malformed events defensively as conflicts, although legal traces contain only valid events.
result.holds: (input,out)=>{if(!Array.isArray(out)||out.length!==input.events.length)return false;let n=1,v=0,a=[];for(let k=0;k<input.events.length;k++){let e=input.events[k],s='accepted',old=a.find(x=>x[0]===e.id);if(old)s=old[1]===e.seq&&old[2]===e.delta?'duplicate':'conflict';else if(e.seq<n)s='stale';else if(a.some(x=>x[1]===e.seq))s='conflict';else a.push([e.id,e.seq,e.delta]);if(s==='accepted')for(;;){let x=a.find(x=>x[1]===n);if(!x)break;v+=x[2];n++}let p=a.filter(x=>x[1]>=n).map(x=>x[1]).sort((x,y)=>x-y),q=out[k];if(!q||Object.keys(q).length!==4||q.status!==s||q.value!==v||q.next!==n||JSON.stringify(q.pending)!==JSON.stringify(p))return false}return true}
